First stable release of **Flood Zoning & Evacuation Planner** for QGIS 3.34 or newer (QGIS 4 supported).

**Tools** (Processing Toolbox → Flood Zoning & Evacuation Planner)
1. River corridor – river channel polygon and protection buffer
2. Spatial planning zones – no / restricted / conditional development and river protection zones
3. Evacuation zones – settlements at risk, grouped by type, optionally never across the river
4. Safe havens and evacuation routes – one safe haven per zone and least-cost walking routes
5. Report tables – key figures and plain-language tables in Word or HTML

📖 [User guide with a worked example](https://github.com/uzairkhan26/Flood-Zoning-Evacuation-Planner/blob/main/docs/user_guide.md)

**Install:** download `flood_zoning_evacuation_planner-1.0.0.zip` below, then in QGIS *Plugins → Manage and Install Plugins → Install from ZIP*. No extra Python packages needed.

See [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/uzairkhan26/Flood-Zoning-Evacuation-Planner/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for details.
